supported_claims: The ordering-only analyzer rejects cross-host ordering between two distinct local-only clock domains.
The route epoch and explicit Fabric identities can match without making the clocks comparable.
FIPS MMP loss_rate remains a link-estimator value and is not equated with SRT loss, drop, or retransmission counters.
non_claims: The synthetic fixture is not a live or simultaneous SRT-over-FIPS capture.
It does not identify a first divergent layer, failure domain, or root cause.
It does not pass G4 or authorize control actions.
